name: 24083 · Daleville, VA
findings: ZIP 24083 (Daleville) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24083 (Daleville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 24083 (Daleville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
